Third-party notices for the TI-99/4A libretro core
===================================================

1. Speech synthesizer: src/speech.c, src/speech.h, src/speech_tables.h
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
These files are a C99 re-implementation of the TMS5200 / CD2501E linear-predictive-coding speech
synthesizer and the TMS6100 voice synthesis memory (VSM) controller. The algorithms, the state
machine behaviour and the coefficient tables (energy, pitch, K1-K10, chirp, interpolation) are
derived from the MAME project's source files

    src/devices/sound/tms5220.cpp / tms5220.h
    src/devices/sound/tms5110r.hxx
    src/devices/machine/tms6100.cpp

which are licensed under the BSD-3-Clause licence by their authors:

    tms5220.cpp / .h : Frank Palazzolo, Aaron Giles, Jonathan Gevaryahu, Raphael Nabet,
                       Couriersud, Michael Zapf
    tms5110r.hxx     : Frank Palazzolo, Couriersud, Jonathan Gevaryahu
    tms6100.cpp      : hap, Couriersud

src/speech_tables.h is generated from tms5110r.hxx by tools/gen_speech_tables.py.

2. Built-in cartridge list: src/softlist_data.h
----------------------------------------------
Generated by tools/gen_softlist.py from MAME's hash/ti99_cart.xml (cartridge names, board types,
ROM/GROM file names, sizes and offsets only; no ROM data). That file is dedicated to the public
domain under CC0-1.0 ("license:CC0-1.0" in its header).

3. No ROM images are included
-----------------------------
The console ROMs/GROMs (ti99_4a.zip), the speech vocabulary ROM (ti99_speech.zip) and cartridge
images are copyrighted and are NOT part of this package; supply your own MAME-compatible copies.
